name: Jhulian Ramírez
title: Senior Software Architect · Cloud & AI
profile: Senior Software Architect with over a decade of experience and more than five years defining the architecture of production platforms. Works with Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture, hexagonal architecture, and modular design (LIQUID) to keep large systems cheap to change. Defined the reference architecture for SmartFarm and led digital lending, document management, and LLM agent systems for EPM, XM, Comfamiliar Risaralda, and Medellín's city hall. Brings AI tooling into the development cycle —code generation, assisted review, and automated testing— where it shortens the cycle without eroding quality. Mentors and runs code reviews with BI, ML, AI, and Data Engineering teams. Cloud work primarily on Azure (deployment, Azure DevOps, Cosmos DB), with AWS foundations.

experience.description: Accountable for the architecture of the SmartFarm platform: designing and implementing robust, scalable, and clean architectures that underpin high-quality software development. Applies modern architectural paradigms —Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and modular design patterns such as LIQUID— to maximize maintainability, product evolution, and team agility, defining technical standards, context boundaries, and cross-cutting development guidelines.
highlights: Defines and governs the platform's reference architecture: domain separation and bounded contexts (DDD), API contracts, and LIQUID modularization strategies that enable each capability to evolve independently.

Integrates AI-powered tools across the entire development lifecycle —code generation, intelligent peer reviews, automated testing, and refactoring assistance— accelerating delivery while raising software consistency and quality.

Leads code reviews and continuous improvement processes, and provides mentorship and technical guidance to cross-functional Business Intelligence (BI), Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Data Engineering teams.
Aligns technology evolution with business value, translating strategic objectives into documented architecture decisions, explicit trade-offs, and technical standards adopted across teams.
